profile.headline: Software Developer at Oracle Corporation
profile.summary: Driven professional with a demonstrated expertise in the healthcare information and technology sector. Proficient in SQL, VB6, Patient Access, Healthcare Information Systems, Foreign Systems Integration, Custom Scripting, Technical Documentation, and Databases. Possessing a Bachelor of Science degree in Information Technology from The University of Missouri in Columbia.

positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Design and develop robust, scalable tools and frameworks for automating build, test, and deployment processes within the CI/CD pipeline.
positions.insights: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), SQL and +2 skills

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer II
positions.insights: Jenkins and Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP)

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description: A Technical Support Engineer will oversee and maintain their computer hardware and software systems. Their skills assist the company in resolving technical issues concerning customer's accounts or company software infrastructure. This role will also support computer software integration by diagnosing and troubleshooting common problems.

positions.title: Interface Engineer
positions.description: Responsibilities include building and testing interface design and provide interface support during implementation activities. As well as Configuring Cerner interfaces and code basic interfaces, installing Cerner interfaces and troubleshoot and resolve system interface issues. In addition, support interface testing during the life cycle of the project, perform data migration and conversion programs and test data migration and conversion programs.
positions.insights: Unix, Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) and +1 skill

positions.title: Technical Solutions Analyst
positions.description: A Technical Solution Analyst provides functional and technical expertise to Cerner's clients and collaborates with project teams who are implementing Cerner software. This role is responsible for solution related service request investigation, incident resolution and application maintenance. Our Technical Solution Analysts are also responsible for creating and maintaining educational documentation and knowledge transfer materials.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designing, coding and modifying The University of Missouri's website, from layout to function and according to a client's specifications. Strive to create visually appealing sites that feature user-friendly design and clear navigation.

company.name: YMCA of the University of Missouri

positions.title: Mobile Sales Consultant
positions.description: Selling a broad range of mobile products and services using a proven structured approach while at the same time developing in-depth knowledge of the latest mobile technology. The position is supported with an intensive orientation and ongoing training program. Engages customers utilizing selling skills to build connected solutions while maintaining a balance of high velocity and high service.
